description: Graphe de la mobilité - Graphe ferroviaire régional is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Le nouveau graphe ferroviaire régional est la réunion en une seule couche de 3 graphes d'origines différentes: - Le graphe ferroviaire genevois (GMOFERROVIAIRE) - Le graphe ferroviaire de swisstopo issu du swissTLM3D 1.9: classe d'entités TLMEISENBAHN du thème TLMOEV, pour le reste de la Suisse - Le graphe ferroviaire francais issu de la BDTOPO V3 ... Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
